\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R120-first-pass-describing-words-and-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a country and a story.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item hot, cold, slowly, fast, expensive
  \item cheap, empty, rich, poor, dirt; dirty
  \item clean, sweet, thick, thin, light
  \item true, green, yellow, red, blue
  \item black, white, brown, pink, young
  \item old, a week, a month, a year, an hour
  \item a minute, today, now, always, sometimes
  \item early, lateness; late, before, after, time
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Hot? (\textbf{\mr{गरम}}, \emph{garam}.) Cold? (\textbf{\mr{थंड}}, \emph{thaṇḍ}.) Slowly? (\textbf{\mr{हळू}}, \emph{haḷū}.) Fast? (\textbf{\mr{जलद}}, \emph{jalad}.) Expensive? (\textbf{\mr{महाग}}, \emph{mahāg}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\mr{स्वस्त}}, \emph{svasta}.) Empty? (\textbf{\mr{रिकामा}}, \emph{rikāmā}.) Rich? (\textbf{\mr{श्रीमंत}}, \emph{shrīmant}.) Poor? (\textbf{\mr{गरीब}}, \emph{garīb}.) Dirt; dirty? (\textbf{\mr{घाण}}, \emph{ghāṇ}.) Clean? (\textbf{\mr{स्वच्छ}}, \emph{svachchha}.) Sweet? (\textbf{\mr{गोड}}, \emph{goḍ}.) Thick? (\textbf{\mr{जाड}}, \emph{jāḍ}.) Thin? (\textbf{\mr{बारीक}}, \emph{bārīk}.) Light? (\textbf{\mr{हलका}}, \emph{halkā}.) True? (\textbf{\mr{खरे}}, \emph{khare}.) Green? (\textbf{\mr{हिरवा}}, \emph{hirvā}.) Yellow? (\textbf{\mr{पिवळा}}, \emph{pivḷā}.) Red? (\textbf{\mr{लाल}}, \emph{lāl}.) Blue? (\textbf{\mr{निळा}}, \emph{niḷā}.) Black? (\textbf{\mr{काळा}}, \emph{kāḷā}.) White? (\textbf{\mr{पांढरा}}, \emph{pāṇḍhrā}.) Brown? (\textbf{\mr{तपकिरी}}, \emph{tapkirī}.) Pink? (\textbf{\mr{गुलाबी}}, \emph{gulābī}.) Young? (\textbf{\mr{तरुण}}, \emph{taruṇ}.) Old? (\textbf{\mr{म्हातारा}}, \emph{mhātārā}.) A week? (\textbf{\mr{आठवडा}}, \emph{āṭhavḍā}.) A month? (\textbf{\mr{महिना}}, \emph{mahinā}.) A year? (\textbf{\mr{वर्ष}}, \emph{varṣa}.) An hour? (\textbf{\mr{तास}}, \emph{tās}.) A minute? (\textbf{\mr{मिनिट}}, \emph{miniṭ}.) Today? (\textbf{\mr{आज}}, \emph{āj}.) Now? (\textbf{\mr{आता}}, \emph{ātā}.) Always? (\textbf{\mr{नेहमी}}, \emph{nehmī}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\mr{कधीकधी}}, \emph{kadhīkadhī}.) Early? (\textbf{\mr{लवकर}}, \emph{lavkar}.) Lateness; late? (\textbf{\mr{उशीर}}, \emph{ushīr}.) Before? (\textbf{\mr{आधी}}, \emph{ādhī}.) After? (\textbf{\mr{नंतर}}, \emph{nantar}.) Time? (\textbf{\mr{वेळ}}, \emph{veḷ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Places, the town, clothes and numbers — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R120-second-pass-places-the-town-clothes-and-numbers}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for far and inside.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item far, inside, outside, behind, ahead
  \item a shop, a road, a lane, a station, a car; a train
  \item a bus, a bridge, a temple, an office, the police
  \item a boat, a bicycle, a market, a village, clothes
  \item a shirt, a sari, a sock, a pocket, a ring
  \item a watch, a cap, a shoe, a sandal, thirty
  \item forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, ninety
  \item a hundred, a thousand, the world, a colour, a journey
  \item a holiday, music, news, a country, a story
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Far? (\textbf{\mr{दूर}}, \emph{dūr}.) Inside? (\textbf{\mr{आत}}, \emph{āt}.) Outside? (\textbf{\mr{बाहेर}}, \emph{bāher}.) Behind? (\textbf{\mr{मागे}}, \emph{māge}.) Ahead? (\textbf{\mr{पुढे}}, \emph{puḍhe}.) A shop? (\textbf{\mr{दुकान}}, \emph{dukān}.) A road? (\textbf{\mr{रस्ता}}, \emph{rastā}.) A lane? (\textbf{\mr{गल्ली}}, \emph{gallī}.) A station? (\textbf{\mr{स्टेशन}}, \emph{sṭeshan}.) A car; a train? (\textbf{\mr{गाडी}}, \emph{gāḍī}.) A bus? (\textbf{\mr{बस}}, \emph{bas}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\mr{पूल}}, \emph{pūl}.) A temple? (\textbf{\mr{मंदिर}}, \emph{mandir}.) An office? (\textbf{\mr{कार्यालय}}, \emph{kāryālay}.) The police? (\textbf{\mr{पोलीस}}, \emph{polīs}.) A boat? (\textbf{\mr{होडी}}, \emph{hoḍī}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\mr{सायकल}}, \emph{sāykal}.) A market? (\textbf{\mr{बाजार}}, \emph{bājār}.) A village? (\textbf{\mr{गाव}}, \emph{gāv}.) Clothes? (\textbf{\mr{कपडे}}, \emph{kapḍe}.) A shirt? (\textbf{\mr{सदरा}}, \emph{sadrā}.) A sari? (\textbf{\mr{साडी}}, \emph{sāḍī}.) A sock? (\textbf{\mr{मोजा}}, \emph{mojā}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\mr{खिसा}}, \emph{khisā}.) A ring? (\textbf{\mr{अंगठी}}, \emph{aṅgṭhī}.) A watch? (\textbf{\mr{घड्याळ}}, \emph{ghaḍyāḷ}.) A cap? (\textbf{\mr{टोपी}}, \emph{ṭopī}.) A shoe? (\textbf{\mr{बूट}}, \emph{būṭ}.) A sandal? (\textbf{\mr{चप्पल}}, \emph{chappal}.) Thirty? (\textbf{\mr{तीस}}, \emph{tīs}.) Forty? (\textbf{\mr{चाळीस}}, \emph{chāḷīs}.) Fifty? (\textbf{\mr{पन्नास}}, \emph{pannās}.) Sixty? (\textbf{\mr{साठ}}, \emph{sāṭh}.) Seventy? (\textbf{\mr{सत्तर}}, \emph{sattar}.) Ninety? (\textbf{\mr{नव्वद}}, \emph{navvad}.) A hundred? (\textbf{\mr{शंभर}}, \emph{shambhar}.) A thousand? (\textbf{\mr{हजार}}, \emph{hajār}.) The world? (\textbf{\mr{जग}}, \emph{jag}.) A colour? (\textbf{\mr{रंग}}, \emph{raṅg}.) A journey? (\textbf{\mr{प्रवास}}, \emph{pravās}.) A holiday? (\textbf{\mr{सुट्टी}}, \emph{suṭṭī}.) Music? (\textbf{\mr{संगीत}}, \emph{saṅgīt}.) News? (\textbf{\mr{बातमी}}, \emph{bātmī}.) A country? (\textbf{\mr{देश}}, \emph{desh}.) A story? (\textbf{\mr{गोष्ट}}, \emph{goṣṭa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
